title: Who Carries a Creative Vision Into Production?
author: RN Collins
rightsRule: Evidence leads; atmosphere never substitutes for provenance.

carouselA.title: Who Carries a Creative Vision Into Production?: the institutional sequence

frames.caption: Creative vision reaches production through negotiated translations among people, factories, contractors, files, budgets, standards, law, and material limits; the process distributes power rather than merely executing a designer’s command.
frames.alt: Title plate for Who Carries a Creative Vision Into Production?.

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 01 · TRANSLATE — What does “the vision” mean operationally?. Turn aesthetic direction into testable specifications while preserving the reason behind them: material, construction, tolerance, finish, movement, color, hand, durability, repair, packaging, cost, timing, and acceptable variation.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what does “the vision” mean operationally? within Who Carries a Creative Vision Into Production?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 02 · LOCATE LABOR — Who performs each transformation?. Name the actual employer, worker, contractor, vendor, or licensee where verified; record jurisdiction, role, classification source, wage-and-hour review, safety route, language access, and subcontracting uncertainty. Do not let a purchase order erase people.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who performs each transformation? within Who Carries a Creative Vision Into Production?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 03 · ALLOCATE POWER — Who can approve, reject, revise, pause, and be paid?. Bind decisions to thresholds, response times, evidence, escalation, payment milestones, change-order treatment, quality disputes, intellectual-property terms, confidentiality, and termination. “Final approval” must name both subject and consequence.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping who can approve, reject, revise, pause, and be paid? within Who Carries a Creative Vision Into Production?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.crop: native 4:5 diagram; preserve labels and evidence footer
frames.caption: 04 · CLOSE THE LOOP — What returns from production to the house?. Capture deviations, defects, worker or supplier feedback, material substitutions, fit outcomes, quantities, waste, cost changes, approvals, corrected specifications, provenance, and archive records so production knowledge can alter the next collection.
frames.credit: Concept and editorial design: RN Collins
frames.alt: Diagram mapping what returns from production to the house? within Who Carries a Creative Vision Into Production?.
frames.rights: Original publication graphic; no third-party imagery
frames.treatment: render from verified text, source IDs, lines and geometric fields

frames.caption: A highly documented production system can improve accountability yet push surveillance and paperwork onto workers with the least power. A house can also use technical standards to demand impossible precision without paying for development or change. Documentation must support remedy, learning, and fair allocation—not merely brand protection.
frames.alt: Counterpoint card for Who Carries a Creative Vision Into Production?.
frames.treatment: typographic quotation field; no decorative imagery

frames.caption: Identify every place where subcontracting, classification, pay, safety, or decision authority is unknown.
